stem: Jatin's calculator starts at $0$ and has buttons $+1$, $+10$, $+100$, and $+1000$. He wants the display to show exactly $420$.

options.text: $4$ presses of $+100$ and $2$ presses of $+10$ make exactly $420$.
The powers of ten are the display value $420$.
Pressing buttons is what creates the place-value buttons $+1$, $+10$, $+100$, and $+1000$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: 4×100 + 2×10 = 400 + 20 = 420, so those button clicks make the target.

teacher.key_rationale: 420 can be made as 4 hundreds and 2 tens. Calling the powers of ten the value 420 swaps terms. Saying presses create the buttons reverses the relation.
